document: D2 CxK SAP pre-unlock amendment decision log
trigger: Public QC identified method ambiguity and mechanically unavailable displacement inputs while all real effect results remained sealed.

decisions.decision: Scheme B uses exactly outcome-relative months -12 through -4. H_B is any monthly ERA5-Land P90 exceedance in those nine months. D_B is any SPI-3 <= -1.0 with endpoint -10 through -4 only. C_B is H_B AND D_B. K_B is any overlapping fatal UCDP GED 26.1 event within 50 km during the nine-month window.
Derive scheme-B country event files from the frozen UCDP GED 26.1 global ZIP because scheme-A country files have insufficient temporal envelopes.

Withdraw the v1.0 200-position perturbation sensitivity without replacement. Current inputs lack verified Admin-2 boundaries and resampleable climate rasters matching the official displacement restriction; double-jittering a displaced point cannot recover the true point.
Nigeria displacement is restricted to LGA (Admin-2).
Burkina Faso displacement is restricted to Province (Admin-2).
Retain 25 km and 100 km as distance-threshold robustness checks only. They are not displacement corrections. Treat displacement-related exposure measurement error as a limitation.

authorization.task_04_only_additional_run: scheme B followed by repeated sealed dual-run QC
